caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular textile sample centered on a plain, off-white background. The textile appears to be woven, featuring alternating vertical bands of red, beige, and blue arranged in distinct rectangular and geometric patterns. The left section consists of three horizontal blue rectangles, each filled with intricate, repeating motifs separated by thin beige bands. The middle and right sections contain vertical and diagonal blue patterns on a beige background, framed by red vertical stripes. The whole textile is bordered by thick red bands on all four edges. The composition is precise, and the drawing uses primarily red, blue, and beige colors in a repetitive, geometric arrangement. There are faint pencil markings and text below the woven design on the background paper.
title: Woven Textile
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
